rules.title: Prefer a conditional expression for a simple value choice
rules.description: A short value assignment is easier to scan when the condition and both outcomes stay together.
rules.message: Use a ternary expression when this branch only chooses between two values. Keep if/else when either branch performs work or needs multiple statements.

rules.title: Use const or let instead of var
rules.description: Block-scoped declarations make mutation and variable lifetime clearer.
rules.message: Use const by default, or let when reassignment is required.

rules.title: Use strict equality
rules.description: Strict comparisons avoid implicit coercion and make the accepted value types explicit.
rules.message: Replace == or != with === or !== unless coercion is deliberate and documented.

rules.title: Remove direct console debugging
rules.description: Ad-hoc console output is noisy and bypasses structured logging and redaction conventions.
rules.message: Remove debugging output or route intentional diagnostics through the project logger.

rules.title: Do not swallow errors silently
rules.description: An empty catch block hides failures and leaves future readers unable to tell whether ignoring the error is intentional.
rules.message: Handle, report, or explicitly document why this error can be ignored.

rules.title: Do not pass an async callback to forEach
rules.description: forEach does not await async callbacks, which makes completion and error handling misleading.
rules.message: Use for...of for sequential work or Promise.all with map for deliberate concurrency.

rules.title: Use any instead of interface{}
rules.description: The any alias communicates an intentionally unconstrained Go value more clearly.
rules.message: Use any unless the older spelling is required for compatibility.

rules.title: Avoid deprecated ioutil APIs
rules.description: Modern io and os APIs are clearer and keep new code off the deprecated compatibility package.
rules.message: Use the equivalent io or os package API.

rules.title: Resolve temporary code markers
rules.description: TODO and FIXME markers should become a tracked issue or be resolved before the change is merged.
rules.message: Resolve this marker or link it to a concrete tracked issue with enough context.

rules.title: Keep lint suppressions narrow
rules.description: File-wide or rule-unspecified suppressions hide unrelated problems and make future violations invisible.
rules.message: Name the exact rule being suppressed and keep the suppression on the smallest possible scope.
